entries.title: Lineup moves without the scroll

entries.title: The Oilers fan zone
entries.line: A page for the Oilers: the verdict on their season with a grade, strengths and weaknesses ranked against all 32 clubs, a luck check and what management and the coaches should do about it; who's rising and who's fading, the goalies and the prospects; the latest news, the last ten games and the next few; and the history, from the 1984 Cup to the rafters.
